div.div: كَلِمَةٌ فَاذَّةٌ , and ↓ فَذَّةٌ , i. q. شَاذَّةٌ [i. e. A word, phrase, proposition, or sentence, extraordinary, or exceptional, in respect of rule, or of usage]. (M, L.) And آيَةٌ فَاذَّةٌ A verse of the Kur-án that is alone in meaning. (L.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
